name: gorgons
description: A game of lines on a hexagonal board. Nothing jumps or slides: every piece steps one cell, and spearmen only ever step forward. What reaches across the board is sight. A gorgon freezes the first enemy piece on each of its three lines for as long as it stands there, and since a gaze stops at the first piece of either side, every piece is at once a target and a screen. That is the question each move asks: open a line or close one. A piece stepping into a gaze is frozen and helpless, prey for a spearman or the oracle, but it also blinds the gorgon to everything behind it; a screen that steps away discovers the gaze on whatever it was hiding, yours or theirs. Two gorgons that see each other freeze each other and stay staring, a standoff only a third piece can break, and a frozen gorgon or lure still sees. The lure reaches into the enemy's wall and draws a spearman out of it, one step toward you, and because spearmen never go back it stays drawn: out of the screen it was making, into your gaze, or onto a cell your spearmen take. Because every spearman step is for good, the game cannot idle: armies close, the middle fills with frozen pieces that serve as living walls, and it ends when the oracle, which steps only one cell, is caught frozen beside an attacker, or when a side's spearmen have run out of road and everything else is frozen, so that it has no move at all.
summary: Each gorgon stares down three lines, a third of a turn apart, to the edge of the board. If the first piece on a line is an enemy, it is frozen: it cannot move or threaten, but still blocks.
Any piece in a gaze line, of either side, stops the gaze there, so every piece is also a screen.
Spearmen only go forward: one step to either of the two cells ahead, taking an enemy piece there. They never come back.
Your lure sees the first piece on each of the six lines, up to two cells away. If that is an enemy spearman, you may step it forward, toward you, onto an empty cell, as your move.
Gorgons, lures and the oracle step one cell any way. Only the oracle and spearmen take.
There is no check: win by taking the enemy oracle, or when your opponent has no legal move.
